🚨 AI & ML Problem Statement
  • Rare-Event Imbalance (1:300): Major X-flares comprise <0.3% of solar hours; standard ML collapses to all-quiet majority class.
  • Cross-Sensor Temporal Delay: Fast non-thermal electrons drive delayed plasma heating; black-box ML violates physical causality.
Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) Solar Eruption & Impulsive X-Ray Flare Phenomenon
💡 Proposed AI & ML Solution
  • 5-Node Graph Transformer: Models cross-spectral electromagnetic coupling across SoLEXS & HEL1OS sensors.
  • Differentiable PINN Regularization: Embeds Neupert plasma equation with GradNorm multi-task dynamic balancing.
Aditya-L1 Orbit at Sun-Earth L1 (1.5M km) with Dual X-Ray Spectrometers
⚙️ Key Machine Learning Innovations
  • Spatial & Causal Attention: Dual-axis multi-head attention over passbands and sliding time windows.
  • Positive Parameter Clamping: Learnable coronal cooling (β ≥ 0.001) & non-thermal injection (α ≥ 0.01).
  • Mondrian Conformal Sets: 95% guaranteed coverage prediction bounds eliminating false alarms.
🧠 Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer Neural Architecture PyTorch Deep Learning Model
Multi-Task Thermodynamic PINN Loss: L_total = L_focal + λ(t) × || d(SXR)/dt - (α × HXR - β × SXR) ||²
• Dynamically balanced via GradNorm (α ≥ 0.01, β ≥ 0.001)
• Constrains predictions to adhere to plasma energy conservation.
PINN Cooling Parameter Convergence vs. Spitzer Loss
🔄 End-to-End AI/ML Training & Real-Time Operational Pipeline
1 Spectral Graph Formulation
  • Ingests 5-band X-ray streams from SoLEXS & HEL1OS.
  • Constructs fully-connected 5-node spectral graph.
  • Linear projection to 64-dim embedding tensor.
2 Spatial-Temporal Attention
  • Spatial Attention: 4 heads learn cross-band energy coupling.
  • Causal Temporal Attention: 4 heads attend to precursor history.
  • Masking prevents future telemetry leakage.
3 PINN Optimization
  • Multi-task: Class-balanced focal loss + Neupert differential loss.
  • GradNorm dynamically balances gradient magnitudes.
  • Clamped parameters enforce thermodynamic consistency.
4 Conformal Alerts
  • Mondrian non-conformity calibration on held-out split.
  • Guarantees finite-sample 95% coverage prediction sets.
  • Dispatches sub-12ms warning alerts to satellite fleets.
